# Statement of Work: Tallgrass Dispatch and Customer Portal Transformation

**Prepared for:** Tallgrass Freight Lines, Inc.   **Prepared by:** Kestrel Ridge Solutions   **Date:** January 22, 2027

## 1. Executive Summary

Kestrel Ridge Solutions is delighted to partner with Tallgrass Freight Lines to deliver a world class, cutting edge dispatch and customer portal platform that will transform how Tallgrass moves freight. Our seamless, state of the art solution will retire the legacy Microsoft Access application, empower dispatchers across 14 terminals, and give 3,500 business customers a best in class self service experience. With Kestrel Ridge, Tallgrass gets a robust, scalable and intuitive system that is delivered on time and delivers real results from day one.

This Statement of Work responds to Tallgrass RFP TFL-2026-09 and describes the work we will perform.

## 2. Our Understanding

Tallgrass is a regional logistics company with about 900 drivers. Dispatchers plan loads in a legacy desktop application, customers track shipments by phone and email, and orders, invoicing and master data live in the Tallgrass SAP ERP system. Tallgrass wants to cut dispatch planning time, give customers self service access and retire the Access application. We understand that this is a pivotal moment for the company. Every dispatcher, driver and customer will feel the difference, and the new platform must support Tallgrass as it grows across its terminals and customer base for many years to come. Kestrel Ridge brings the people, the technology and the passion to make that happen.

## 3. Our Solution

Kestrel Ridge will design, build and deploy, on .NET and React in the Tallgrass Azure subscription, the following solution components, including but not limited to:

1. A dispatch application for dispatchers and terminal managers, with load planning, driver and vehicle assignment, route sheets, exception handling and a live map of active loads.
2. A customer portal with order entry, shipment tracking, proof of delivery documents, invoice view and user management for customer administrators.
3. A mobile friendly driver view for accepting loads and recording status events.
4. Integration with the Tallgrass SAP ERP system through its published APIs and OData services, and with the Tallgrass telematics provider for live vehicle positions.
5. Integration with any other third party systems used by Tallgrass, as required.
6. Migration of historical dispatch data from the legacy Access database.
7. Single sign on for staff with Microsoft Entra ID, role based access for customers and an audit log of administrative actions.
8. Testing, deployment, training and knowledge transfer.
9. All future enhancements needed to keep the system aligned with Tallgrass business processes and related activities.

The portal will be fast, highly available and able to handle Tallgrass volumes with ease. Customers will enjoy a delightful, intuitive experience on any device, and dispatchers will see their planning time fall dramatically.

## 4. Our Approach

Kestrel Ridge applies a flexible, collaborative approach built on industry best practices. We listen closely to dispatchers, terminal managers and customers, and we deliver working software early and often so that Tallgrass sees progress at every step. Our experts will work hand in hand with the Tallgrass IT team, the business analysts for each terminal group and the Operations product owner to make sure the solution reflects how Tallgrass really works. We will migrate data carefully, test thoroughly and train every user so that go live is smooth and stress free.

## 5. SAP Integration and Configuration

SAP is at the heart of the Tallgrass business and Kestrel Ridge is a trusted SAP partner. Our SAP certified consultants will configure the SAP SD pricing procedures and the SAP transportation management freight order types and status codes needed to support the new dispatch process, in both the QA and production systems. We will also integrate with the transportation management system once it goes live.

## 7. Timeline

The project starts on March 15, 2027. Design runs from March 15 to April 30, build from May 3 to August 27 and testing and user acceptance from August 30 to September 24, with production go live on September 30, 2027. SAP integration development begins on April 5, 2027, before the Integration Specification is delivered. Delivery will take place in two releases, an internal dispatch release followed by the customer portal. Cutover will avoid peak freight periods. Kestrel Ridge will keep Tallgrass fully informed at every stage and will adapt the plan quickly as priorities evolve, so that the team can respond to the needs of the business with agility.

## 8. Team and Effort

The project requires 14,400 hours of effort, delivered by a core team of 6 consultants led by Imani Clarke (Project Manager), Viktor Lindqvist (Technical Architect) and Nadia Perez (Lead Developer). Resumes are available on request. No subcontractors will be used. Our team is highly experienced, deeply committed and ready to start on day one.

| Phase | Hours |
|---|---|
| Design | 1,600 |
| Build | 9,200 |
| Testing | 2,400 |
| Training and deployment | 1,200 |
| Total | 14,400 |

Our agile approach keeps the team flexible. Tallgrass has read access to Azure DevOps for the backlog, repositories and pipelines. Weekly status reports are provided and a monthly steering committee is held. Any changes to scope will be agreed between the project managers.

## 9. Investment

The investment for this project is USD 1,850,000, based on a blended rate of USD 135 per hour. The dispatch application and customer portal are fixed price. Integrations, data migration and training are time and materials and the final amount may vary. Rates for work outside this SOW range from USD 140 to USD 260 per hour. Azure hosting costs are paid directly by Tallgrass. Travel is reimbursed at cost.

| Item | Price (USD) |
|---|---|
| Dispatch application | 620,000 |
| Customer portal | 540,000 |
| Integrations | 310,000 |
| Data migration | 180,000 |
| Training | 95,000 |
| Total | 1,850,000 |

Invoices are issued monthly and are payable net 30.

## 10. Support and Warranty

Kestrel Ridge warrants the delivered software against defects for 12 months from go live. During the warranty and afterwards, we will provide 24x7 support for dispatch operations and the portal, including on-site support at Tallgrass terminals when required, because Tallgrass operates around the clock. Issues will be resolved quickly.

## 11. Why Kestrel Ridge

Kestrel Ridge has extensive experience delivering logistics and freight solutions and a proven track record of success. Our people are among the best in the industry, our delivery model is trusted by leading companies, and our commitment to customer success is second to none. We stand behind our work and will go the extra mile to make Tallgrass successful. We hold a SOC 2 Type II report and data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Tallgrass will own the custom software and documentation, and Kestrel Ridge retains its pre existing tools. Kestrel Ridge carries all insurance required by the RFP. We look forward to a long and prosperous partnership with Tallgrass and to working side by side with every team.
